swordskill.skill.how_to_use.description:
== How to use Sword Skills ==
Switch skills with A / D and assign a skill usable with your current weapon
to a slot. Press the slot's key to activate the skill.
Use the mouse wheel to turn the pages of this text.

== Unlocking skills ==
Spend one Skill Orb (found in chests) to unlock a skill.
Some skills also require a certain proficiency in that weapon category;
the Unlock button shows how much you need.

== Proficiency ==
Proficiency is stored per weapon category (one-handed sword, dual swords, axe...).
Defeating monsters with a skill of a category raises its proficiency.
Every 100 proficiency grants one level-up point, and the "Level Up" button
in the selection screen raises one skill of that category by one level.
Skill levels only affect damage: Lv.1 is x1.00 and Lv.10 is x3.00.

== Planned ==
Cooking, throwing and smithing categories will be added later;
their proficiency will rise when the matching action succeeds.
